description: This file defines a React component called PanelResizer used for resizing panels in a web UI. It manages user interactions like dragging and double-clicking to resize or collapse panels, and handles related DOM manipulations and callbacks.

classes.name: PanelResizer
classes.description: A React component enabling resize functionality for a panel, supporting drag, double-click, and resize events, with internal state management and DOM interactions.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Sets up event listener for double-click on the resizer element after component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates width, left position, and collapsed state when props change.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes event listeners to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Calculates and applies the width of the panel, optionally finalizing the resize and triggering callbacks.

methods.name: setLeft
methods.description: Sets the left position of the panel element.

methods.name: onDblClick
methods.description: Handles double-click to toggle panel collapse/expand.

methods.name: handleWidthEvent
methods.description: Handles resize based on mouse movement for width adjustments.

methods.name: handleLeftEvent
methods.description: Handles resize based on mouse movement for left position adjustments.

methods.name: computeMaxWidth
methods.description: Calculates maximum allowable width based on parent container.

methods.name: onMouseDown
methods.description: Initiates resize operation, adding overlay and recording initial positions.

methods.name: onMouseUp
methods.description: Completes resize operation, removes overlay, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: onMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse movement during resize, delegating to width or left handlers.

methods.name: addInvisibleOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay to capture mouse events outside iframe boundaries during resize.

methods.name: removeInvisibleOverlay
methods.description: Removes the overlay added during resize.
